measurement.note: Every outcome below was measured against PractRand 0.95 with the seed above. failsBy is the smallest PractRand length at which a definitive FAIL was observed; a run whose budget is under that length cannot discriminate the control and is reported as inconclusive rather than as a harness fault. cleanThrough is its mirror for a generator expected to pass: the largest length at which a clean run was actually observed. It exists because a pass is only evidence at a depth where something worse would have been caught -- SystemRandom, rated Poor here, is clean through 4GB and only fails at 8GB, so the 1GB evidence these entries used to carry distinguished nothing. scripts/tests/test-random-quality-outcomes.mjs refuses a pass recorded shallower than the deepest control's failsBy.

generators.name: BlastCircuitRandom
generators.reason: Chaotic ARX mixer; clean through 8GB with no anomalies.

generators.name: DotNetRandom
generators.reason: Weak by rating, but not assertable as a control at any budget measured so far. It reflects into the host System.Random's internal state, so its stream is runtime-dependent by construction: the .NET 9 stream this host emits is not the Mono stream Unity ships. Measured clean through 16GB under .NET 9, so a pass is always reported as inconclusive rather than as a harness fault.

generators.name: FlurryBurstRandom
generators.reason: Six-word ARX generator; clean through 8GB with no anomalies.

generators.name: IllusionFlow
generators.reason: Rotate/xor/add generator on a Weyl counter; clean through 8GB with no anomalies.

generators.name: LinearCongruentialGenerator
generators.reason: Expected-failure control. Raw-state Numerical Recipes LCG: bit k has period 2^(k+1), so the low byte collapses almost immediately.

generators.name: PcgRandom
generators.reason: PCG XSH RR 64/32; clean through 8GB with no anomalies.

generators.name: PhotonSpinRandom
generators.reason: SHISHUA-inspired generator; clean through 8GB with no anomalies.

generators.name: RomuDuo
generators.reason: ROMU multiplier with a modified duo update; clean through 8GB with no anomalies.

generators.name: SplitMix64
generators.reason: SplitMix64 mixer; clean through 8GB with no anomalies.

generators.name: SquirrelRandom
generators.reason: Expected-failure control at 1GB and above. The Squirrel3 hash shows a reproducible FPF-14+6/16 deficiency at exactly 1GB across four independent seeds, matching its 'not extensively tested beyond moderate ranges' rating. Good enough for table lookups, not for a statistical battery.

generators.name: StormDropRandom
generators.reason: Large-state ARX generator over a 1024-word ring; clean through 8GB with no anomalies.

generators.name: SystemRandom
generators.reason: Expected-failure control. Knuth subtractive lagged-Fibonacci; survives 4GB and fails the low-byte BCFN test at 8GB, so only budgets of 8GB or more discriminate it.

generators.name: WaveSplatRandom
generators.reason: Expected-failure control. Single-word chaotic generator with no formal test results; fails BCFN and DC6 within the first 64KB.

generators.name: WDoomRandom
generators.reason: Expected-failure control. A 1024-entry lookup table of 32-bit values with period 1024 draws; the stream repeats every 4KB, so Gap-16 catches it at 8KB. Deterministic by design and not statistically random at all.

generators.name: WyRandom
generators.reason: Wyhash-based generator; clean through 8GB with no anomalies.

generators.name: XoroShiroRandom
generators.reason: Expected-failure control. xoroshiro128+ low 32 bits are linear: bit 0 has linear complexity exactly 128, which the binary rank test detects overwhelmingly by 16MB.

generators.name: XorShiftRandom
generators.reason: Expected-failure control. Classic 32-bit xorshift is a pure GF(2) linear map, so the binary rank test collapses it inside 64KB.

generators.name: Xoshiro128StarStar
generators.reason: xoshiro128** 1.1; the ** scrambler leaves no weak bit. Clean through 1GB with no anomalies.

generators.name: Xoshiro256StarStar
generators.reason: xoshiro256** 1.0; the ** scrambler leaves no weak bit. Clean through 1GB with no anomalies.
